_comment: The graph. node-types.json says which edge a verdict selects; this says where an edge leads. A route target is a node, another edge, or a terminal — several deterministic steps can sit between two judgment points. Edge and node names share one namespace and may not collide, which the validator enforces.

verify-fast._note: exit 2 is the gate itself being broken. It never routes to repair — a repair node handed an unrunnable gate would 'fix' code that was never the problem.

commit._note: The chunking plan is judgment and came from the Builder. Executing it is not, so it happens here.

to-repair._note: Attempt count is edge state carried in the token. Exhausting the budget routes to a human node — an edge, not an exception.

finance-c-and-c._note: The whole of 'finance always waits for me'. Real money, real tax lots, real wash-sale windows — one inserted node, and its removal is not on the table.
